description: This file defines types and functions for interacting with Microsoft Teams channels via the Graph API, including listing channels and retrieving detailed channel information.

methods.name: listChannelsMSTeams
methods.description: Lists channels in a specified Microsoft Teams team using the Graph API, supporting pagination up to 10 pages.

methods.name: getChannelInfoMSTeams
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Microsoft Teams channel via the Graph API.
